ui.description: React component layer using Material-UI for building user interfaces

required_patterns.react-typescript: All components are React.FC with TypeScript types
required_patterns.tss-react-hooks: tss-react with makeStyles() for styling hooks

architectural_constraints.component-structure: Functional components with hooks, no class components
architectural_constraints.type-enforcement: Props must be explicitly typed via interfaces/types
architectural_constraints.styling-location: Styles either colocated in .module.css, in separate styles.ts files using tss-react makeStyles(), or inline with Emotion
architectural_constraints.mobileresponsiveness: MUI breakpoints (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) for responsive design

routing.description: Client-side routing using React Router v5 with role-based access control

required_patterns.react-router: React Router DOM 5.2.0 with Route, Switch, Redirect components
required_patterns.route-structure: Organized by feature: AdminRoutes, BookingFlowRoutes, etc.
required_patterns.private-routes: PrivateRoute component wraps protected routes and checks user permissions
required_patterns.role-based-access: PERMISSIONS array in permissions.ts defines route access by role

architectural_constraints.route-organization: Routes organized in separate route files by feature/domain
architectural_constraints.permission-checking: All admin routes must go through PrivateRoute and permission check
architectural_constraints.route-constants: All route paths centralized in routes/constants.ts
architectural_constraints.query-params: Query parameters handled via useQueryParams() custom hook

state-management.description: Redux-based global state management using Redux Toolkit

required_patterns.redux-toolkit: Redux Toolkit with configureStore() for store setup
required_patterns.reducers: Feature-based reducers in store/reducers/{feature}/ with reducer.ts, actions.ts, types.ts
required_patterns.thunk-actions: Async operations via Redux Thunk middleware
required_patterns.persistence: Redux Persist maintains auth state and settings across page reloads
required_patterns.selectors: createSelector() patterns used in pricingSettings for memoized selectors

architectural_constraints.reducer-pattern: Each reducer has three files: types.ts (interfaces), actions.ts (creators), reducer.ts (logic)
architectural_constraints.typing: All reducers and actions are fully typed with TypeScript
architectural_constraints.action-flow: All state mutations go through Redux, no direct DOM state
architectural_constraints.thunk-pattern: API calls wrapped in Redux Thunk actions that dispatch actions on success/failure
architectural_constraints.immutability: Redux Toolkit uses Immer under the hood for immutable updates

data-layer.description: Centralized API client and HTTP request management via Axios

required_patterns.axios-setup: Axios instance created in api/request.ts with baseURL set to APIUrl
required_patterns.interceptors: Request/response interceptors handle auth tokens and errors
required_patterns.api-endpoints: API methods organized in api/api.ts exported as API object
required_patterns.typed-responses: All API calls return typed Promise<AxiosResponse<T>>

architectural_constraints.single-client: All HTTP requests must go through axios instance in api/request.ts
architectural_constraints.auth-header: Authorization header automatically set from authService.getLocalToken()
architectural_constraints.session-id: SessionId header added for self-booking flows
architectural_constraints.error-handling: 401 responses trigger token refresh via authService.refresh()
architectural_constraints.type-definitions: All API request/response types defined in api/types.ts

authentication-and-authorization.description: Multi-role authentication system with JWT tokens and permission-based access

required_patterns.roles: Multiple roles: EvenFlowAdmin, ServiceManager, Staff, etc. defined in types/types.ts
required_patterns.permissions: PERMISSIONS array maps routes to allowed roles
required_patterns.private-route: PrivateRoute component checks user permissions before rendering
required_patterns.token-storage: Tokens stored in localStorage for admin, sessionStorage for self-booking
required_patterns.auth-service: AuthService in api/AuthService/ handles token get/set operations

architectural_constraints.role-check: hasPermission() utility function validates user role for route access
architectural_constraints.two-auth-flows: Admin flow (localStorage tokens) and self-booking flow (sessionStorage/temp tokens)
architectural_constraints.token-refresh: Automatic token refresh on 401 response via interceptor
architectural_constraints.logout-handling: Tokens cleared and user redirected to login on auth failure
architectural_constraints.permission-denied: Routes inaccessible to user are blocked by PrivateRoute

forms-and-validation.description: Form input handling and data validation across booking and admin interfaces

required_patterns.controlled-inputs: All form inputs controlled via React state
required_patterns.validation-hooks: useValidation() custom hook for form validation logic
required_patterns.input-components: Standardized form control components in components/formControls/
required_patterns.error-display: Form errors displayed inline with red text and error states

architectural_constraints.no-uncontrolled: All input elements must have value and onChange handlers
architectural_constraints.validation-on-blur: Validation typically occurs on input blur and form submission
architectural_constraints.error-messages: Validation errors mapped to user-friendly messages
architectural_constraints.required-fields: Required fields marked with asterisk and validated before submission

modals-and-dialogs.description: Modal dialog implementation using MUI Dialog and custom BaseModal wrapper

required_patterns.base-modal: BaseModal component wraps MUI Dialog with consistent styling
required_patterns.modal-state: Modal open/close state managed via Redux (modals reducer)
required_patterns.useModal-hook: useModal() custom hook provides modalopen, setOpen helpers

architectural_constraints.centralized-control: Modal visibility controlled through Redux state
architectural_constraints.no-local-state: Modal open/close should not use local component state except through useModal hook
architectural_constraints.consistent-styling: All modals use BaseModal wrapper for consistent appearance

notifications-and-messages.description: User notifications via Notistack snackbars and message handling

required_patterns.notistack: Notistack SnackbarProvider wraps app for global notifications
required_patterns.notification-types: success, error, warning, info notification types supported
required_patterns.dispatch-notifications: Redux notifications reducer manages notification queue

architectural_constraints.global-provider: SnackbarProvider must be at top level in App.tsx
architectural_constraints.no-alerts: Use Notistack instead of alert() for all notifications

date-and-time.description: Date/time handling using Dayjs and MUI date pickers

required_patterns.dayjs-library: Dayjs 1.11.10 for date manipulation (lighter than moment)

architectural_constraints.consistent-library: Use Dayjs for date operations, not native Date or moment
architectural_constraints.iso-format: Dates serialized/deserialized in ISO format for API calls

drag-and-drop.description: Drag-and-drop interfaces using React DnD and @hello-pangea/dnd libraries

required_patterns.react-dnd: React DnD 16.0.1 for complex drag-drop logic
required_patterns.item-types: ItemTypes constant defines draggable item types
required_patterns.dnd-components: DragableTable and Card/Container components in components/DragAndDrop/

architectural_constraints.backend-driven: Drag-drop reordering persisted to backend via API calls

required_patterns.useTranslation-hook: useTranslation() hook provides t() function for string translation

architectural_constraints.no-hardcoded-strings: Never hardcode user-facing strings; all must use i18n
architectural_constraints.translation-keys: Translation keys use hierarchical dot notation

analytics-and-monitoring.description: User tracking and error monitoring via Google Analytics and Sentry

required_patterns.google-analytics: react-ga and react-ga4 for GA integration
required_patterns.analytics-hook: useAnalyticsBySCId() hook tracks events per service center

architectural_constraints.event-tracking: Key user actions tracked via analytics events
architectural_constraints.error-reporting: Uncaught errors automatically reported to Sentry

error-handling.description: Global error boundary and exception handling

required_patterns.useException-hook: useException() hook centralizes error display via notifications
required_patterns.fallback-ui: FallBack component shown when error occurs
required_patterns.error-logging: Errors logged to Sentry for monitoring

architectural_constraints.async-errors: API errors handled in Redux thunk actions
architectural_constraints.ui-errors: Form/validation errors displayed inline with inputs

virtualization-and-performance.description: Large list rendering optimization via virtualization

required_patterns.react-window: react-window 1.8.6 for virtual scrolling of large lists
required_patterns.react-virtualized-auto-sizer: Auto-sizer wrapper for responsive virtual lists
required_patterns.pagination: usePaginations() hook manages paginated data loading

architectural_constraints.virtualization-required: Tables with 100+ rows must use virtualization

responsive-design.description: Mobile-responsive UI built with MUI breakpoints

required_patterns.mui-breakpoints: useMediaQuery() hook detects screen size changes
required_patterns.mobile-first: Design starts mobile and scales up
required_patterns.responsive-components: Booking flow has separate mobile-optimized component versions

architectural_constraints.responsive-required: All pages must work on mobile (xs), tablet (md), and desktop (lg+)
